cap_logic: No service floor can exceed R1 if owner_accountability is blank or evidence is absent.
No service floor can exceed R2 unless a named loadcase and degraded mode or assurance test exist.
No high-stakes service floor can be R3 or R4 if civil-rights, language-access, disability-access, no-digital/no-ID paths are untested.
No high-stakes service floor can be R4 if material corrective actions are open, unfunded, or unretested.
No high-stakes service floor can be marked assured or R4 without independent audit/redress or a public challenge path.
No high-stakes service floor can exceed R2 when required roles are single points of failure or credentials/succession are untested.
No contract-dependent service floor can exceed R3 if planning/tender/award/contract/milestone/payment/complaint evidence is missing.
High-stakes floors require owner, current evidence, loadcase test, excluded-user path, corrective closure, independent redress, workforce depth, and assurance-case records before R4.

No nuclear clean-firm service floor can exceed R2 if operations performance, oversight indicators, outage/refueling, maintenance/spares, operating-experience, grid-service, public-scorecard and SQLite/data-quality evidence are missing or stale.

No nuclear integrated-energy service floor can exceed R2 if cogeneration, district heat, process heat, desalination, hydrogen/clean molecules, data-center/critical-load, public-value, water/ecology, dispatch-priority, or red-team exception evidence is missing or stale.
